notes.title: Multiplayer, Jungle & more coming soon! (Developer update)
notes.content:
http://i.albe.pw/rvMSw.gif

Within the next few weeks a lot more big features are being added to the game!
I am currently developing quite a few new features, some of them being;


    Multiplayer
    3 multiplayer gamemodes
    New environment! Jungle.
    Trading cards


These features will be added within the next few weeks as a normal update to the game - no DLC's or anything.

This update is quite big and has taken a long time and now that it's finally close to release. I am looking forward to play the game with you!


If you've got any suggestions, questions or anything really, feel free to ask in the comments!

notes.title: The Checkpoint update (yayy new features + achievements!)
notes.content:
http://i.albe.pw/xLsbx.PNG


New Features

    Checkpoints!
- Every once in a while, a Golden Chain will spawn. If you grab it a checkpoint with 1 life will spawn (Meaning you can respawn at the checkpoint once before it's game over)
    2 new achievements!
    Improved UI
- Settings are now way more cool-looking, and with a couple of new features too like "Replay Tutorial" and "Credits".


More chains will also spawn, so you should never have to wait for new ones! The chains also got a nice makeover, and are now wayyy more shiny and beautiful.

Soon to come

    A couple of new obstacles (like clothing lines)
    Multiple Gamemodes!
- like Zero Gravity and rusty-only!
    More environments
    Multiplayer


Feedback is very welcome anywhere - reviews, the discussion section or here!

notes.title: Achievements, Easter Eggs & Rick Astley
notes.content:
http://i.albe.pw/9pUcd.PNG

Hey there - just a small update here!
Added

    Two new secret achievements
    Easter-eggs!
    Made the start-zone (prison) better in general
    New obstacle - you'll know it when you see it!


Thanks a lot for checking by. There will be a few more of these minor-content additions the next couple of days, and then some major ones later on next week! Multiplayer is coming very soon with two game-modes: Capture The Flag and Last Man Standing - so look forward to that happening in a couple of weeks!

We are also currently working on multiple environments so you don't have to look at the same ol' town over and over (even though it's randomly generated) - with this, we'll also add turns in the road, and new obstacles along the way!

Thanks for the support so far - please don't hesitate to suggest features or ask questions in the Discussion section.
Happy swinging!
